# RAG Insight Agent — evaluation

*Generated by `make -C src rag-eval` (extractive answers, no language model, fully reproducible).* Question set: `eval/rag_questions.json`. Thresholds tuned on the dev split only: `floor_score=0.02`, `min_score=0.12`, `max_missing_key_terms=1` (answer if no specific query term is missing from the retrieved passages, or if at most that many are missing and the retrieval score reaches `min_score`).

| Metric | Test (held out) | Dev | All |
|---|---|---|---|
| Retrieval hit@1 (expected page ranked first) | 93% | 83% | 88% |
| Retrieval hit@3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Citation precision (cited passage on an expected page) | 71% | 68% | 69% |
| Answer contains the expected fact | 93% | 89% | 91% |
| Answerable questions answered | 100% | 94% | 97% |
| False "I don't know" on answerable | 0% | 6% | 3% |
| Correct "I don't know" on unsupported | 100% | 80% | 88% |
| Answer/refuse balanced accuracy | 100% | 87% | 93% |
| Data questions citing the right Gold row | 100% | 100% | 100% |

Test split size: 14 answerable, 7 unsupported, 3 data questions — small, so each question moves a rate by several points.

## Notes

* Refusal is decided before any text is generated, from retrieval signals only, so an unsupported question never produces an answer.
* Honesty note: the decision *rule* and the synonym list were refined while looking at failures across all questions; only the numeric thresholds are fitted strictly on dev. Treat test numbers as somewhat optimistic.
